patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ADP Workforce Now and BambooHR share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose ADP Workforce Now only if your buying job matches “Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no publis” rather than BambooHR's shape. Choose BambooHR only if your buying job matches “SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee/mo above ” rather than ADP Workforce Now's shape. Workflow advantage: ADP Workforce Now leans shared coverage; BambooHR leans core-hris. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — ADP Workforce Now and BambooHR share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: ADP Workforce Now is Mid-market payroll + HR (Select / Plus / Premium packaging) — custom PEPM quote; no published seat $. Landscape vs Gusto.; BambooHR is SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee/mo above 25 employees, or $250/mo flat floor for smaller te.
- Company-size focus: ADP Workforce Now (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs BambooHR (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: ADP Workforce Now-leaning — vs BambooHR-leaning core-hris.
- Researched limits: ADP Workforce Now — No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; BambooHR — Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO.

Limitations — ADP Workforce Now: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras; Time, talent, and benefits depth live on Plus/Premium or add-ons; BambooHR: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO; Teams of 25 or fewer pay a $250/mo floor, so effective PEPM is far above $10.

Poor-fit cases: ADP Workforce Now is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published PEPM — invoices can include garnishment/W-2 extras · BambooHR is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Payroll, benefits, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons — Core PEPM is not full HCM TCO · Avoid ADP Workforce Now if you actually need BambooHR's motion (SMB/mid-market core HRIS with Core/Pro/Elite PEPM tiers — Core from $10/employee)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
